start: Monthly report of a finished month with 12 workouts on 10 days, all timed

steps.action: Open the monthly report and tap the send icon 'Share as a picture'
user_sees: Picture with 'Monthly report', the month's title, '12 workouts · 10 days trained'
Four boxes: TIME, KG LIFTED, SETS, LIFTS UP
The month as a calendar starting Monday, trained days filled in orange
'MOST TRAINED' with up to 3 exercises and their sets
must_not: '1 days' or '1 workouts'
Body weight counted in KG LIFTED
A trained day missing from the calendar or a day in the wrong weekday column

steps.action: Tap 'Share picture'
user_sees: The share sheet with the PNG
must_not: A picture of another month

start: Another kind: the year in review

steps.action: Open the year in review and tap 'Share as a picture'
user_sees: 'Year in review', '<year> in review' (or '<year> so far'), the workouts and days line
HOURS (or TIME under an hour), KG LIFTED, SETS, LIFTS UP
12 month bars J to D, the busiest one brighter
'HIGHLIGHTS': 'Favourite: <exercise>', 'Busiest month · 9 workouts', 'Longest streak', 'Biggest gain'
must_not: 'HOURS 0' for a short year
A busiest month with no count beside it

start: Another way in: the Profile tab's share of this month

steps.action: On the Profile tab tap the share of this month's report
user_sees: '<Month> so far' on the picture for a month not yet over
must_not: The month called complete before it ends
A second sheet opening on a fast second tap

start: A month with no workouts, or a month of only pull-ups, or logged by chat with no length

steps.action: Open a report with no workouts
user_sees: No share icon on the report
must_not: A picture of zeros
'KG LIFTED 0'

steps.action: Share a month of only body-weight moves
user_sees: 'REPS' in the second box, or 'DISTANCE' for runs, or 'WORKOUTS'
must_not: 'KG LIFTED 0'

steps.action: Share a month where 2 of 12 workouts have no length
user_sees: '12 workouts, 10 timed · ...'
must_not: The time read as the whole month's

steps.action: The report fails to load on the Profile share
user_sees: 'Could not make the picture' with 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
must_not: An endless spinner

start: A month in progress, then finished

steps.action: Share this month on the 15th
user_sees: '<Month> so far'
must_not: The full month title

steps.action: Share the same month after it ends, with a workout added on the last day
user_sees: The full month title; the last day filled; counts up by one
must_not: 'so far' still on a finished month
The last day's workout missing

start: What the report picture can give away

steps.action: Read every word and number of the month and year pictures
user_sees: Only workouts, days, time, kg or reps, sets, lifts up, exercise names
The line 'The picture never shows your name, your gym or your body weight.' (or the gym version)
must_not: Body weight, measurements or a body weight chart
A pair of numbers that divide back to body weight
